body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (currently amended): A vehicle control device configured to control a vehicle, comprising:
an information provision device configured to provide information to a driver of the vehicle;
a processor, during automated driving control of the vehicle, configured to:perform the automated driving control by automatically performing a driving operation of the vehicle relating to a driving plan of the vehicle control device, the automated driving control comprising operations relating to at least one of acceleration,
steering, and braking, according to the driving plan;provide, through the information provision device to the driver, a driving event that is to occur at a point ahead in a direction of advance from a current point, based on an automated driving plan;
judge a suitability of a driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being performed by the driver at a point before the point of the driving event, the driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being a lane change; andprovide the driver with judgment information indicating that the driver not perform the driver driving operation, based on the judging of the suitability determining that performing the driver driving operation is unsuitable according to the driving plan
being executed by the vehicle control device, the judgment information comprising lane change inhibiting information indicating that a lane to be changed to is unable to be driven on at the point before the point of the driving event.
2. (canceled).
3. (currently amended): The vehicle control device according toclaim 2 claim 1,wherein the processor is further configured to:
display, on an information display screen visible to the driver, as the lane change inhibiting information, a specialized icon showing that the lane to be changed to is to at least one of disappear due to the lane reduction and be unable to be driven on at the point before the point of the driving event.
4. (currently amended): The vehicle control device according toclaim 2 claim 1,wherein the processor is further configured to:
display, on an information display screen visible to the driver, as the lane change inhibiting information, the lane to be changed to is to at least one of disappear due to the lane reduction and be unable to be driven on at the point before the point of the driving event.
5. (currently amended): The vehicle control device according toclaim 2 claim 1,wherein the processor is further configured to:
provide to the driver, together with the lane change inhibiting information, distance information from the current point to the point where the lane to be changed to is to at least one of disappear due to the lane reduction and be unable to be driven.
6. (currently amended): An information provision method providing a driver through an information provision device mounted in a vehicle with a driving event which is to occur at a point ahead in a direction of advance from a current point based on a driving plan prepared during automated driving where a driving operation of the vehicle is automatically performed that relates to the driving plan, the driving operation comprising operations relating to at least one of acceleration, steering, and braking, according to the driving plan,
the information provision method comprising:judging a suitability of a driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being performed by the driver at a point before the point of the driving event the driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being a lane change; andproviding the driver with judgment information indicating that the driver not perform the driver driving operation, based on the judging of the suitability determining that performing the driver driving operation is unsuitable according to the driving plan being performed, the judgment information comprising lane change inhibiting information indicating that a lane to be changed to is unable to be driven on at the point before the point of the driving event.
7. (currently amended): A non-transitory computer-readable recording medium storing a computer-executable program that, when executed by at least one processor of a device, cause the device to:
provide a driver through an information provision device mounted in a vehicle with a driving event which is to occur at a point ahead in a direction of advance from a current point based on a driving plan prepared during automated driving where a driving operation of the vehicle is automatically performed that relates to the driving plan, the driving operation comprising operations relating to at least one of acceleration, steering, and braking, according to the driving plan;
judge a suitability of a driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being performed by the driver at a point before the point of the driving event, the driver driving operation corresponding to the driving event being a lane change; and
provide the driver through the information provision device with judgment information indicating that the driver not perform the driver driving operation, based on the judging of the suitability determining that performing the driver driving operation is unsuitable, according to the driving plan being performed, the judgment information comprising lane change inhibiting information indicating that a lane to be changed to is unable to be driven on at the point before the point of the driving event.
